annotations.title: Find hotels with a direct booking link

description: Find hotels in one city for exact dates and guests, each with the provider's real total price for the cheapest room and ONE link that opens that room's checkout with the hotel, dates, guests and room already chosen. Give the person the link: they only add their own details and pay. GeoLocale does not book or take payment; the guest pays the booking provider. Prices are totals for the whole stay in the currency shown, as the provider quotes them now, and a room can be sold before the link is opened. A hotel the provider has no room for on those nights is not listed.

checkin.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD, today or later.

checkout.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD, after checkin, at most 30 nights.

children.description: The age of each child, if any.

city.description: City name or GeoLocale's id for the city, for example "lisbon".

currency.description: Three-letter currency code for the prices, for example "EUR". Default EUR.

limit.description: How many hotels to return, cheapest first. Default 8.

max_price.description: Leave out hotels whose total for the stay is above this, in the chosen currency.

min_stars.description: Leave out hotels with fewer stars.

name: find_stays
